name: claude-oversized-output
description: Misbehavior (test-plan §1): oversized output. The agent emits a single stream event whose line is at least 1 MiB long — a well-formed assistant/text envelope with an enormous text field, so only the line *length* is anomalous. Exercises the consumer's line-size guard (no unbounded buffering / OOM). emit_oversized generates the filler so the scenario file stays tiny; never schema-validated.
